definitions.gloss: ordinary times; usually; as a rule
definitions.explanation: One's usual, everyday state or conduct, as opposed to special occasions. A formal written word, most familiar from the opening line of business letters.

examples.japanese: {平素|へいそ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}った→実る：00282_minoru⟧。
{平素|へいそ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけている→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I make a habit of looking after my health.

examples.japanese: {平素|へいそ}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{格別|かくべつ}→格別：00154_kakubetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{引|ひ}き{立|た}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{賜|たまわ}り→賜る：07659_tamawaru⟧、⟦{厚|あつ}く→厚い：00690_atsui⟧⟦{御礼|おんれい}→御礼：31158_onrei⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: We sincerely thank you for your continued patronage.

notes:
REGISTER:
Formal and mostly written. In conversation the same idea is ⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧ or ⟦{日頃|ひごろ}→日頃：07284_higoro⟧; {平素|へいそ} belongs to letters, speeches and announcements.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {平素|へいそ}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧: as always (the stock opening of a business letter or notice)
- {平素|へいそ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: usually, at ordinary times
- {平素|へいそ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行|おこな}い→行う：01238_okonau⟧: one's everyday conduct
- {平素|へいそ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: as a matter of habit
